messages:
Samir: Quick: capture owners + abort criteria from the KV-cache OOM postmortem. Need backups and explicit timelines.
Anya: Ill own profiling/RCA. Plan: 2 snapshots per shard (low/high churn), diff, upload flamegraphs. ETA: Fri EOD.
Javier: Ill own config rollout (soft_limit -> 0.72, lru_aggressive) + canary automation. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m windows. Abort if p95 +20ms or evictions >2x. Backup: Priya.
Priya: Telemetry + alerts. Adding fragmentation_ratio per-shard and kv_residency_bytes per-model. Alert: fragmentation delta >12% for 10m -> page eng-runtime. Will add dashboard tile. ETA: Thu EOD.
Lena: Ill build an emergency slab_compact job with a two-approver UI toggle; safety: no-op if CPU>70%. ETA: 48h.
Samir: Owners recap + deadlines noted. Make sure PRs reference the postmortem doc and include rollback steps.
Anya: Profiling commands (short):
kv_snapshot --shard=$S --out=/artifacts/kv-$S.$TS.snap
kv_diff /artifacts/kv-*.snap > /artifacts/diff.$TS.txt
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2240012345/.
Javier: Short config snippet: shard_defaults: { soft_limit_ratio: 0.72, eviction_policy: lru_aggressive }. Will add per-model prefix_warmer toggle.
Priya: Runbook short: trigger -> fragmentation_delta >12% OR evictions/sec>150 for 10m; steps -> disable warmers top3 models, throttle writers (10%), run slab_compact (2 approvers), escalate after 30m.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder created: "KV OOM followups" 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC attendees: eng-runtime.
Samir: Thanks. Weekly triage for 6 weeks; first check-in next Mon. If abort criteria hit during canary, run rollback automation and page oncall immediately.
